newsitem.title: UK: French mull autumn France Telecom sale - FT.
newsitem.headline: French mull autumn France Telecom sale - FT.

text.p: French ministers expect to partially privatise state-owned telecoms firm France Telecom this autumn, ahead of the liberalisation of Europe's telecommunications markets in 1998, the Financial Times said on Thursday.
The paper said ministers expected to press ahead with the sale of a minority interest in the firm -- in what it said could be France's largest privatisation -- as soon as September or October.
On Wednesday a poll found a majority of French people favoured the public sale of shares in France Telecom.
The poll found that 68 percent backed either a total or partial privatisation of the firm, compared to 27 percent who opposed its sale and five percent who expressed no opinion.

The FT said a sale in the autumn would show a clear shift from the stance adopted by the Socialist government in the recent general election campaign and put strain on relations with its Communist coalition partners.
